_about: CENTURIA 16 (Chiron by a tuner): its speedometer is painted (bug_chiron_17_gaoge_diff, 512 px: 0 to 500 km/h, 0 at the bottom left round the top to the bottom right, 28 degrees each 50 km/h) and its needle is modelled (its own material, gradient_012_diff): it turns about the dial's hub along the scale as the driver sees it (modelled pointing a little below 0; each 50 km/h's turn measured from the driver's eye: marks). The left screen (interior_emissive.001, stored upside down: flip_v) is the rev counter, a dotted arc from 0 at its lower left up to 8 at its upper right, with the power scale inside it: the revs light the dotted arc. The right screen (display_right_diff) is the Chrono page: its lap time drawn after Lap time. Every dial and screen glows at night. Screen pixels: the picture as it's seen; hub: m from the steering wheel's centre (x right, y up, z back); axis: the dial's face.
